mood: Editorial, Typographic, Refined, Focused. A mix between a theatre script, linguistics workbench, and music notation app.

headings.usage: Page titles, large section headers, empty state hero text.

script_body.usage: The actual English text of the audition scene. Use text-2xl or text-3xl for immersive reading, tracking-normal, leading-relaxed.

phonetics_mono.usage: IPA symbols, phonetic transcriptions, small labels, UI buttons. Gives the 'linguistics workbench' vibe.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. The script reading area must feel like a physical piece of paper, with plenty of negative space.
spacing_and_layout.scale: Tailwind standard, prioritize p-8, p-12, p-16 for main containers.
spacing_and_layout.structure: Dual-pane editor layout. Left: Script Workspace (width: 65%). Right: Laundry Lists & Tools (width: 35%). Use 1px sharp borders to separate them (no shadows).
spacing_and_layout.grid_borders: Use border-collapse style. Panels separated by border-r border-[#E5E1D8]. No rounded corners.

word_block.description: The atomic unit of the app. Contains the English word and its IPA transcription beneath it.
word_block.layout: Flex-col, items-center, gap-1, p-2 -mx-2 rounded-sm transition-colors

buttons.primary: bg-[#1C1B1A] text-[#FDFDFB] hover:bg-[#C85A4F] rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.15em] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: border border-[#E5E1D8] bg-transparent text-[#1C1B1A] hover:bg-[#E5E1D8]/50 rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.15em] transition-colors

cards_and_panels.style: Flat, 0px border-radius (sharp), 1px solid border-[#E5E1D8]. NO SHADOWS. Neumorphism and glassmorphism are banned here to keep the 'ink on paper' feeling.

laundry_list_badge.style: inline-flex items-center gap-2 border border-[#E5E1D8] px-3 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-[#1C1B1A] hover:border-[#C85A4F] cursor-pointer

motion.hover: Instant or very fast (100ms) background changes on word blocks so it feels highly responsive to quick scanning.
motion.transitions: Slide-in from right for the Laundry List panel. Subtle fade-ins for loaded text.

images.description: Minimalist paper texture for empty states when no PDF is uploaded. Apply mix-blend-multiply and low opacity (10-20%).
Close up book writing texture for the login/marketing landing page.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all IPA text passes WCAG AA against the warm sand background.
accessibility.interactive: All clickable word blocks MUST have data-testid='word-block' and an aria-label indicating pronunciation playback. All buttons must have specific data-testid (e.g., 'upload-pdf-button', 'add-laundry-list-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind for styling. Override default shadcn styles to remove border-radius (rounded-none) to match the editorial, print-design look.
Install Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS: Cormorant Garamond, Crimson Text, IBM Plex Mono.
For the main reading view, create a continuous flowing flex-wrap container so the text wraps naturally like a paragraph, but each word is its own discrete block (the 'word_block').
Implement the 'Laundry List' panel as a sticky sidebar on the right.
Use lucide-react for UI icons (Play, List, Plus, Trash).
CRITICAL: Generate .js and .jsx files exclusively. Do not create .tsx or .ts files.
Maintain the strict 'Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy' color palette. Do not inject default blues or purples.
